name: Brown Butter Upside-Down Apple Cake
desc: Spiced brown butter cake baked over apple wedges in a sticky honey caramel and flipped out warm.

source.title: Brown Butter Upside-Down Apple Cake
source.evidence: Saved Instagram reel; caption and on-screen text captured in the owner's saved-recipes export

ingredients.raw: 2 firm apples (Pink Lady, Honeycrisp or Fuji), peeled, cored and cut into 1/2 in wedges
ingredients.prep: peeled, cored and cut into 1/2 in wedges

ingredients.raw: Oil spray or softened butter, for the pan

steps: Brown the stick of butter in a small saucepan over medium heat, stirring often, until the milk solids turn brown and smell nutty. Pour into a bowl right away and cool completely, about 20 min.
Line a 9 in round cake pan with parchment and grease it generously. Arrange the apple wedges in a spiral over the bottom.

Melt the 6 tbsp butter in a small saucepan, turn the heat to high, and add the honey and 1/4 cup sugar. Boil about 3 min, until frothy and caramelized. Pour over the apples right away, covering them evenly.
In a medium bowl, whisk the flour, baking powder, cinnamon, ginger and salt.
In another bowl, whisk the cooled brown butter, granulated sugar, brown sugar, eggs, vanilla and milk.
Stir the wet mixture into the dry until evenly combined. Spread over the apples.
Bake 45-50 min, until the top springs back when lightly pressed and a toothpick in the center comes out clean.
Cool 10 min, loosen the edge with a paring knife, set a plate on top and flip both together. Dust with powdered sugar if you like. Serve warm or at room temperature.
tips: Pink Lady, Honeycrisp or Fuji hold their shape.
Cool the brown butter fully so it does not cook the eggs.
